I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0002, which paged on-call.

1. **Problem:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west. It was failing health checks with an 18% error rate.

I tried again and it worked, so there's only one incident and on-call was paged once. The incident covers the failure, the rollback, the current health and a next step: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 problem before deploying it again.
